images.caption: Figure 2:Intuition behindHOTFIXR. The “data space” represents the data samples generated by the question generator. Essentially, we want to hill climb through the data space to find samples that have high lingual deficit scores, as they will be most informative to the student model. By fine-tuning the question generation model to generate samples according to the student model’s lingual deficit, we can improve the information embedded within data, improving our models on downstream tasks.
